device.description: 24-bit 125 kSPS 16-channel delta-sigma ADC with auto-scan multiplexer, GPIO and SPI interface

pages: p.4 power supply (DVDD 2.7-5.25 V), p.5-6 pin assignments, p.7 serial interface timing (Table 1: tDOPD 20 ns, tCSDO 5 tCLK), p.19 data rates (Table 5), p.25 output code (Table 10), p.27-28 conversion control (START pin, pulse convert), p.30-32 reading data and commands, p.33-34 channel data and status byte (Table 12-13), p.35 command byte (Table 14), p.36-40 registers (Table 15-26) (ads1258.pdf; ads1258-ep.pdf has the same content and the PHP/RTC pin configuration)
notModeled: analog inputs, multiplexer, chopping, sensor bias, switch-time delay DLY (stored only)

auto-scan channel sequencing: the channel pointer and STATUS.CHID are not advanced (CHID stays 0); the result is the 0 V code for every channel; the system readings (offset, VCC, TEMP, GAIN, REF) are not computed

Channel Data Read Direct (DIN 000/111 for the first three bits) is the default out pattern [STATUS] R{24}; with fixed-channel mode or STAT=0 the datasheet drops the status byte (Table 17), the model always sends it; after a direct read the datasheet ignores commands until CS toggles
STATUS.OVF and SUPPLY are never set
conversion time is the steady data rate of Table 5 / Table 18 at fCLK = 16 MHz (chop off, delay 0); the initial start delay (Table 11), standby/sleep wake-up and IDLMOD are not modeled
START pin linked to a GPIO via GPIOD writes; GPIO pins are not driven and GPIOD reads do not return pin levels
SPI interface timeout (SPIRST, 256/4096 fCLK), CLKSEL / crystal oscillator / CLKIO clock output
DRDY 1-tCLK high pulse when data are not read
variants: ADS1158 (16-bit, ads1158.pdf) is the same design with a 16-bit result and ID4 = 1; ADS1258-EP (ads1258-ep.pdf) is the enhanced-product version of this device (parts ...EP in this file)
